subject: AXLinkedUIElement and AXServesAsTitleForUIElements across a live Logic plug-in editor window
question: ADR-011 records these two attributes as NOT swept, after AXTitleUIElement was measured absent on every Compressor slider. Does either one pair a value-bearing control with the text that names it?

reverify.command: Manual. With a plug-in editor open, walk every descendant of that window and call AXUIElementCopyAttributeNames on each, counting how many declare `AXLinkedUIElement` and how many declare `AXServesAsTitleForUIElements`. Count the sliders separately from the whole tree so a zero among sliders can be told apart from a zero everywhere.
reverify.expected: Zero, on both attributes, among the sliders AND among every other element in the window.

method: A probe walked the open plug-in window to depth 12 and asked each element for its attribute NAME list, rather than reading the attributes and treating a failure as absence — a read that fails and an attribute that is not declared are different answers, and only the name list separates them. Slider counts are reported beside whole-tree counts so a zero among sliders cannot be mistaken for a blind probe.

observations.what: why Channel EQ does not need the pairing anyway
observations.reading: its sliders carry their parameter name in AXDescription, which is why set_eq_band_verified can address them by name at all

observations.what: the Compressor was NOT reached, and why
observations.attempt_1: the #306 harness refuses with `ambiguous` — the Absolute Zero track holds TWO Compressors, at inserts 0 and 2, and the probe will not choose between two matching slots
observations.attempt_2: the four tracks that hold exactly one Compressor are ALL named `Studio Grand`, so a strip lookup by track name is ambiguous too
observations.attempt_3: `logic_plugins.set_param_verified` against the Compressor's own `plugin_insert_ref` refuses with `plugin_window_plugin_mismatch` because the Channel EQ editor is already open
observations.attempt_4: that editor's close button is not a direct child of its window and could not be pressed by title

conclusion: Logic's plug-in editor window declares NEITHER association attribute anywhere — 0 of 70 elements, sliders included. That is a reading about this window, and it is consistent with the 2026-09-10 finding that no Compressor slider declares `AXTitleUIElement`: the platform's control-to-label association mechanisms appear simply absent from Logic's plug-in views. It is NOT the measurement ADR-011 asks for, because the window measured was the Channel EQ's, whose sliders carry their names in AXDescription and never needed pairing. The Compressor was not reached; four separate routes to it refused, each for a reason worth writing down.
limits: THE COMPRESSOR WAS NOT MEASURED. This record must not be read as closing ADR-011's open sweep. What it establishes is that one Logic plug-in window declares neither attribute anywhere, which makes the Compressor answering differently unlikely — and unlikely is not measured.
One window, one plug-in, one host, one locale. Depth 12.

Attribute NAME lists only. An attribute declared but empty, or one that appears only after some interaction, would read the same as absent here — though a zero in the name list is a stronger absence than a failed read.
The four refusals are reported as operational facts, not as defects. Each is a component refusing to choose between ambiguous targets, which is the behaviour this repository wants.

`AXServesAsTitleForUIElements` was also checked on static text and text fields, not only sliders, and found on none — but the Compressor's parameter NAMES live in text fields, so that half of the question is precisely the one still unmeasured.
